intent: Freeze and exercise the smallest runnable R1 TRANSCRIPT_RETRIEVAL harness while preserving the boundary between local ingest, one real DeepSeek text call per question, deterministic grading, and owner semantic review.
assumptions: The current P0-A owner acceptance and anchor hashes are valid.
The owner has confirmed three local Chinese technical videos, twelve questions, and twelve Gold rows for local evaluation.
The existing FFmpeg/MLX Whisper ingest artifacts contain 127 timestamped VideoSegments and remain the source for retrieval.
The project-root .env supplies the real DeepSeek-compatible text configuration; the answer workflow has no video-provider configuration.
non_goals: Automatic promotion of question or Gold drafts to frozen inputs

closed_follow_up.objective: Improve the fixed regression set with a transparent lexical query-view/score aggregation and a stricter evidence insufficiency prompt without changing media, ASR, segments, questions, Gold, or the TRANSCRIPT_RETRIEVAL boundary.
closed_follow_up.stop_boundary: After the new 12-question run, automatic grading, final report, and the required owner semantic-review checkpoint; no automatic r3 or P1.
closed_follow_up.deepseek_calls: Owner authorized the 12-call run; all 12 calls were attempted once and preserved as provider/APIConnectionError failures. No rerun is permitted in this revision.

active_follow_up.intent: Execute the fixed R2 transcript-retrieval evaluation in a network-enabled context without changing its source, retrieval profile, prompt, questions, Gold, or evidence boundary.
active_follow_up.preflight: At most one disposable P0-A development-sample Chat Completion, only after explicit owner authorization; a failed preflight stops R3 before freeze.
active_follow_up.formal_calls: At most twelve one-call-per-question real answer calls, only after explicit owner authorization; twelve were executed once with no retries or overwrites.
active_follow_up.data_boundary: Provider receives only the current question and current Top-5 transcript segments; no video upload, full transcript, Gold, answer points, or historical answers.
active_follow_up.stop_boundary: Owner-authorized semantic review, the R3 report, and P0B_PASSED_OWNER_ACCEPTED are complete. Stop here; do not make more provider calls or enter P1 without a separate explicit task and authorization.
